sources: all saved original real_controls cohorts, unchanged captions/crops/masks

blocks.null: positive scale/shear only, rotation equivalence fiber
blocks.rotation: canonical 6D of actual local SO(3) rotation changes, other blocks fixed

matching: per clip ||(y-x)/native_reader_std||_2 = radius*sqrt(valid_frames), before reader feature selection; no per-dimension noise amplitude matching
Guo_discards_contacts: Contact budget is matched in full pre-selection263 normalized representation; consumed Guo budget is zero by native architecture
contacts: continuous input ablation; values may leave binary/physical domain
non_null_controls: block-only interventions can be inconsistent with unchanged remaining features; this is input sensitivity, not coherent physical-motion calibration
random_fields: 20261013+10000*rep+clipindex, shared across radii/readers; independent Gaussian fields; fixed null signs both retained
null_matching: positive exponential scales and shear; root solved from norm, never from evaluator scores
outside_rotation_matching: local isotropic axis and angle solved from norm; angle <=pi/2
primary_family: 28 endpoints per reader:14 conditions x (GuoFID,R1 or TMRR1,matchedCosine), Bonferroni t19 mean intervals
closure_diagnostics: all null outputs canonicalized and encoded, separate numerical diagnostics, no additional significance claims
FID_reference: paired original real cohort; zero baseline by construction, not real-world generation quality
